actions.action: Play and use WASD or arrow keys to collect all six checkpoints in order; press R to restart.
actions.expected: Score increases once per checkpoint, completion appears after six, and R resets the route.

actions.action: Edit movement speed in the matching Code, Blocks or Mixed workflow; Undo/Redo, save/reopen, then export Web.
actions.expected: The same authored change affects the running editor and exported game; graph conversion preserves supported code.

actions.action: Open Manage → Build Settings; choose Web, then Windows.
actions.expected: Web is available in the browser; desktop export requires the actual desktop host. Diagnostics give the missing prerequisite before export.

actions.action: Open this project, select Checkpoint 1 and change Transform position X from -6 to -4. In Manage → Build Settings → Team enable the optional workflow and import incoming.nova.
actions.expected: The three-way preview shows base -6, local -4 and incoming -2 for the same identity.

actions.action: Choose the incoming value, apply, Undo, Redo, save/reopen and export Web.
actions.expected: X changes to -2, Undo restores -4, Redo restores -2, and save/export retain the merged value. Independent edits survive.

actions.action: Edit again while reviewing a conflict and try to apply the old preview.
actions.expected: The stale preview is rejected. Reimport the incoming file to review the latest local document.
